summary.headline: Choice Health At Home secures $534K in annual savings across five spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ strategic sourcing program has delivered $534,000 in validated annual savings for Choice Health At Home. A new McKesson contract for Medical Supplies is fully executed, locking in $276K per year, while Fleet, Office Supplies, and two temporary labor categories are in late-stage negotiations representing another $258K. Work included competitive RFPs, supplier benchmarking, and targeted contract renegotiations that reduced costs by up to 22 percent.
